items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we played opposite Bill Doggett’s trio. That’s where we really learned what swing was about.

ctx.x: Bill Doggett. I see a recording session with Bill Doggett in Cincinnati, King Records. Where does that fit in the chronology, and how did it . . . ?
It was probably something that wasn’t released, but then, years later, when we played the Savoy Ballroom, we played opposite Bill Doggett’s trio. That’s where we really learned what swing was about.
